{{Attr|Basic Freeze}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Present''' was an enemy that only appeared in the [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. The '''Present''' was mainly spawned from the [[Papa Bread (Village of Despair)|Papa Bread]]. However, it appeared naturally on Wave 11 as well. While it did not have any abilities to stun towers, it normally appeared in hordes and could pose a serious threat due to its speed. It had more health than the [[Burnt Gingerbread]] while having a similar speed. The '''Present''' was also immune to [[Splash Damage]] and, by extension, the [[Freezer]]'s basic freeze. ==Appearance== The '''Present''' was a red present with a white bow and wrapping. It appeared smaller than other enemies. It had four black legs, resembling something similar to a spider. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger|Outlaw]], [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] and [[Turret]], are recommended against this and the [[Papa Bread (Village of Despair)|Papa Bread]]. **Additionally, you can use [[Commander]] to boost the performance of these towers. *Splash damage towers, like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Demoman]], are useless against the '''Present''' as they are immune to splash damage. **The [[Freezer]]'s basic freeze cannot freeze the '''Presents''', but the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Age'' can freeze them. *You may need the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] to slow the '''Presents''' down, due to their high speed. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **'''Present''' added. *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.1]] **'''Present''' removed. {{VillageOfDespair|[[Papa Bread (Village of Despair)|Papa Bread]]|Wave 10|Present|Wave 11|[[Yeti (Village of Despair)|Yeti]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Present}}
